'''By Bluss''' was a [[Leyakian/Legends|Leyakian]]<ref name="Disappeared Concept" /> [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who held office in the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Parliament]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="HOBS" /> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|310}}</ref> Bluss was present on the Separatist [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]], where they supported<ref name="HOBS" /> senator of<ref name="WOTF">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref> the planet<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]<ref name="WOTF" /> [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri's]] [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|motion for peace]] between the Confederacy and the Republic. When prompted by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the Confederacy, Bluss voted aye. Bonteri's initiative received a majority vote in its favor and was passed on to the Republic's [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], who denied the peace treaty. Bluss had [[Color/Legends|yellowish-brown]] skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Their Separatist Parliament [[Clothing/Legends|outfit]] was white with red and black accents.<ref name="HOBS" />

==Behind the scenes==
By Bluss first appeared in "[[Heroes on Both Sides]],"<ref name="HOBS" /> the tenth episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which released on [[November 19]], [[2010]].<ref name="EpGuideBook">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Episode Guide]]''</ref> The senator was first identified by name in the accompanying [[StarWars.com]] [[The Clone Wars Episode Guides|Episode Guide]], which released on the same day.<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode310.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref> The senator's species was identified in the "Concept Art Gallery" for the Episode Guide for "[[The Disappeared, Part I]],"<ref name="Disappeared Concept" /> the eighth episode of the show's [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions|sixth season]].<ref name="Disappeared Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep608|text="The Disappeared, Part I" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> Despite appearing in concept art made for the episode,<ref name="Disappeared Concept" /> Bluss did not appear in the final product.<ref name="Disappeared">{{TCW|The Disappeared, Part I}}</ref>
